title: 민주화운동기념사업회법 시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:25751:20141119:00007:part:1/1

ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 25751, November 19, 2014>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 5 of these Addenda, amendments to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree entered into force but whose enforcement dates had not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (161) Omitted.

(162) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Korea Democracy Foundation shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, subparagraph 3, "Minister of Security and Public Administration" shall be replaced with "Minister of the Interior".

(163) through (418) Omitted.
